reader.requirement: At --std 85, FUNCTION SIN(argument-1) of any class-numeric argument (radians; literal, expression, any usage, up to 18 digits, ODO element) returns an approximation of its sine that is never below -1 or above +1.

edition-consulted.switches: D8 edition window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 module rows, IntrinsicCatalog.cs#Build) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel; COBOL1502/1503 outside it

ConstructRegistry NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: at 85 a numeric/integer function written where an identifier stands (MOVE sender) is refused (COBOL0900), per §1989:A.2.3 GR2/GR3; never reached inside an arithmetic expression
Edition.DigitCapacityExcess: 18-digit cap on items and literals at 85 (31 later); bounds the argument range only
num.StandardDecimal (OPTIONS ARITHMETIC, a 2002+ paragraph, so always native at 85): the native dispatch is the one a 2023 program with no ARITHMETIC clause takes

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder.cs, IntrinsicRenderer.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ArithmeticMode|StandardDecimal; the runtime bodies take no edition input
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the exact-argument Sin body (quadrant reduction on the exact value) is the same at 85 and 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers ill-conditioned arguments near multiples of pi/2 and an 18-digit integer; not zero, negative COMP-3, expressions, ODO element, or a sweep testing the [-1, +1] bound

probes.printed: COBOL1627 alphanumeric argument; COBOL1504 two arguments
COBOL0900 USAGE FLOAT-LONG at 85; COBOL1639 for SIN(R) without the FUNCTION keyword

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.39.4 RV1  (2.39.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV1

reader.notes: Math.Sin and the reduced-quadrant SinDd/CosDd forms stay inside [-1, +1]. The sweep found no stored or compared value outside it. Output was identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: rtrig1-003 (--std 85): (SIN(x) - 1) * 1E17 into S9(17)V9 COMP-3 is 0 (never positive) for 17-decimal arguments 1.57079632679489656/61/62/70 and -4.7123889803846, and (SIN(-H2) + 1) * 1E17 is 0 (never negative); IF SIN(H2) > 1 and IF SIN(-H2) < -1 never fire; SIN(S9(18) COMP -999999999999999999) = 0.63611020883537050 (mpmath 0.636110208835370488); SIN(3*H2) = -1.0; SIN(0) = 0; SIN(ACOS(-1)) = 1.2E-16 (correct for the binary64 pi); sweep -1000..1000 step 0.0013 (1.5 million arguments, in-condition values) found 0 outside [-1,+1]. FUNCTION PI refused COBOL1502 at 85 (a 2002 function) and floating literal 1.0E1 refused COBOL0900 (rref1-001). cite.py: 'OK  §1989:A.2.39.4 RV1  (2.39.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV1'.
